bibl.title: The Municipalization of Writing in Roman Egypt
bibl.seg: W. Graham Claytor, The Municipalization of Writing in Roman Egypt.
Anne Kolb (ed.), Literacy in Ancient Everyday Life (Berlin - Boston, 2018) pp. 319-334, figg.
bibl.note: Examines the process of municipalization in the province of Egypt and from the point of view of village society, with a particular focus on Greek literacy and notarial institutions: there was a measurable shift in the writing landscape of Egypt between the second and fourth centuries, which involved the concentration of literate men and notarial services in the nome capitals.
